title: HEART OF TIN (1996 DOS, Sandbox Software) — Full Walkthrough, No Commentary
about: HEART OF TIN, played from power-on to the credits: the opening, the story, every level, and the ending, with the game's own music and sound effects. No commentary.

As Mystery Robot Joe passed through every world looking for a real heart, someone was kind to him, and he left a little tin heart behind to say thank you. You found every one. Now walk the Long Road with him, back to every friend he promised to see again, all the way to Watt, the robot who can fix anything.

HEART OF TIN is a Sandbox Software game for Game-Maker: Sandbox Edition, a game in the style of a 1996 DOS release that runs in Recreational Software Designs' Game-Maker 3.0 (PLAYGAME) and in the web app. Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic) wrote and built it: the code, its pictures, music, sounds, and words. Much of it is drawn from Lewis "Lewie" Moten III: his blog writing, photos he provided, and conversations about his interests, experiences, and hobbies. Lewis directed the game and playtested it as it came together.
This video was recorded by the web app itself, frame by frame, at the game's 320×200 resolution.
